Crew managing one of our client's operations at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the <EM4>~mission(Objects) and ships</EM4> in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.
Eddie Par, Michael Shaw, Nine Tails

ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to coordinate the eradication of contraband materials from ~mission(Location|Address). We have learned that there are outlaws using the site for the storage of these illegal items and it is vital that they are destroyed before that can be utilized.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|address).
• Destroy any and all illegal items currently being stored at the site.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with demolition.

ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to assist in the search for ~mission(TargetName) who was last seen near the ~mission(Location) at ~mission(Location|Address) but who's current whereabouts are unknown. 

Our preliminary investigation has led us to suspect foul play may be behind their disappearance. As such, heightened caution is advised as there may be hostile actors involved.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|address).
• Confirm the location of ~mission(TargetName) and if they are still alive.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years security experience.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with conducting missing person investigations.
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.
All right. Well, good to talk to you. Mind how you go. {Sighs}

Okay, stop me if you've heard this one. All right, so, a Banu a Tevar' and a Xi'an are sitting at a bar and the bartender asks, "Which one of you ordered the beer?" The Xi'an all proper like says, "I did not order your disgusting Human beer." Then the Tevar' goes, "I can't afford a beer." And finally the Banu reaches over grabs the beer, chugs it in one gulp. The bartender goes, "Guess you ordered the beer then." And the Banu goes, "What beer?" {Laughs} You get it? Eh? Eh...
{Grunt} Yeah, all right. That was a good one.
That was Amelia Boyd, leader of the Frontier Fighters. Don't let her faze you. Stay focused and let's get this done.
I don't know who she's trying to convince. If she honestly expects us to let them get away with stealing a Polaris, she's crazier than I thought.
